name: startup-config-validation
description: Always-on fail-fast posture: read and validate all required configuration values at app startup so misconfiguration surfaces immediately rather than on the first live request.

source.title: Startup Config Validation Baseline
source.relationship: Mirrored from es-ai-toolkit's startup-config-validation pack — the four validate-at-startup principles are generic ASP.NET Core/.NET practice, not employer-specific, so this personal copy applies to any .NET service work outside iQmetrix.
